NTAP_PRICE.title: NetApp dated Nov 3 regular close, S&P Global via StockAnalysis

peers.peer_role: Subject company, included for juxtaposition; financial inputs audited in companion history work
limitations: Cash field is aggregate cash and short-term investments; separate investments field is zero to avoid double-counting. Restricted cash is excluded.
July capital held unchanged: no operating cash reserve, acquisition cash reserve, or October dividend adjustment. This is gross peer EV, not the DCF equity bridge.
Latest-quarter diluted shares are a valuation proxy, not point-in-time fully diluted shares.
53-week reported TTM versus peers with different fiscal calendars; no synthetic extra-week or acquisition organic-growth adjustment.
Debt is principal, whereas HPE debt is GAAP carrying value.
post_balance_events: Known October dividend and disclosed post-balance acquisitions are not rolled into this stale-capital comparison. Refer to companion valuation for identified cash adjustments and acquisition sensitivities.

post_balance_events.event: PEAK:AIO acquisition completed November 2; no consideration established. JetStream and PEAK:AIO cash usage remains outside the stale-July capital comparison; companion DCF uses an explicitly assumed combined acquisition reserve, not a deal valuation.

peers.peer_role: Core operating competitor, limited valuation anchor because of faster growth and low GAAP margin
peers.debt_note: Zero outstanding revolving borrowings at Aug 2. Immaterial finance lease balances are not quantified and omitted, not asserted to equal zero. Operating leases excluded.

gaap_ebit.note: Reported GAAP income from operations, not net income plus interest/tax.

severance.note: FY2026 charge was in Q1 and rolls out of current TTM; zero TTM addback.

acquisition_transaction.note: Separately identified transaction expense in Q1 FY2027; no SBC, payroll tax or recurring R&D addback.

post_balance_events.event: 1touch acquisition closed May 7, 2026 for $125.9m cash; already included in Aug 2 balance, so do not subtract again.
Sept 23 outlook reaffirmed FY2027 revenue $5.03-5.07bn and non-GAAP operating income $940-960m; new FY2028 outlook revenue $7.0-7.3bn. No post-Aug 2 cash/share roll-forward supplied.

limitations: Latest quarterly diluted shares are not a current fully diluted cap table or spot treasury-stock calculation.
August cash may have changed materially through supply prepayments, repurchases and operating cash flows.
High EV/EBIT reflects only a thin current GAAP margin and is not evidence that NetApp can earn the same multiple.
Issuer non-GAAP operating earnings remove SBC and payroll costs; they are not substituted for this analysis.

peers.peer_role: Secondary diversified storage competitor; financing and networking/server mix preclude direct multiple transfer
peers.diluted_share_period: Q3 FY2026 quarterly weighted average, including 76m mandatory-convertible preferred dilution
peers.debt_note: Reported carrying value of notes/short-term borrowings $2,901m plus long-term debt $17,343m; includes financing/securitization funding. Not exact redemption principal. No separate preferred claim because diluted shares already include conversion. Operating leases excluded.

gaap_ebit.note: Reported GAAP operating income. Captive-financing cost remains in operating expenses.

impairment.note: Goodwill/intangible impairment charges only, no recurring R&D adjustment.

cost_program.note: Retained in primary normalization: repeated cost programs are not presumed non-recurring.

acquisition_disposition_other.note: Full operating reconciliation amounts, including cost-of-sales adjustments; broader than standalone income-statement line. Retained in primary normalization.

transformation.note: Separately reported FY2025 transformation charges; broader sensitivity only.

management_non_gaap_ebit.note: Only for bridge cross-check; not a comparable denominator.

financing_cost.note: Captive customer financing cost included in GAAP operating expenses, retained in base. Supplemental pre-financing-cost sensitivity only.

post_balance_events.event: Telco Solutions disposition completed Aug 1, one day after balance date. Terms were up to $160m including $15m performance incentive. Net cash proceeds, tax and continuing-business EBIT adjustment not established. Base remains unadjusted July balance; $0-160m gross-proceeds-only EV sensitivity is separate and not current net cash.
Common dividend $0.1425 per share payable Oct 16 and preferred $0.953125 per share paid Sept 1 disclosed after balance date. Base is not a full interim cash roll-forward.
Juniper acquired July 2, 2025. Current TTM contains a full year of Juniper; prior-year growth comparisons are not organic. H3C remaining stake sold May 2026, already reflected in July balance.

limitations: Storage is only 10.6% of Q3 revenue; server/networking/captive-finance valuation dominates.

Consolidated EV includes captive financing debt; reported operating profit deducts financing cost. Neither this multiple nor the supplemental pre-financing-cost ratio is a clean industrial storage multiple.
Marketable-investment deduction includes $154m debt investments and $63m equity investments at reported fair value. No value assigned to unfunded pension deficit or unquantified other claims.
July balances and weighted-average shares are stale at Nov 3; Telco sale and dividends make exact current EV unavailable.
Do not average with Everpure or infer an NTAP target from a peer median.

Q3 diluted share proxy: 1,336m weighted-average basic + 76m mandatory convertible preferred if-converted + 37m employee plans treasury-stock method = 1,449m. Actual Aug27 common outstanding 1,327.464779m is a different date and concept. Preferred value is not added separately.
